h.strategy: Before writing hypotheses, decide which field values typically appear in strong configurations and which in weak ones. A condition that fixes such a value mostly selects strong (or weak) parents. Use this deliberately. Strong parents have little room left, so edits that usually help gain less there, and edits that usually hurt lose more. Weak parents sit near a floor, so harmful edits cost little and helpful edits gain a lot. Write at least six hypotheses where this quality effect predicts the opposite direction to the most obvious story about how the parts connect. Write the remaining ones on the strongest effects you are confident in. Use only conditions that many parents satisfy. Spread hypotheses across edited fields and edit values. In each 'why', name the quality mechanism.

hyps.why: A parent with edge 4 removed is a weak cell with lots of headroom, so adding a 3x3 conv on the output edge gains more than when edge 4 already contributes.
A parent with a strong conv on edge 5 is near the ceiling, so the modest skip edit gains little there, while a weak parent gains more.
Strong parents sit near the ceiling and lose more from removing the key input edge, while weak parents are near the floor and have little left to lose.
Replacing an edge in a strong, high-accuracy parent with weak pooling costs more accuracy than in a weak parent already near the floor.
A parent lacking the direct edge 3 is weaker with more room, so adding a conv edge into the output yields a larger gain.
A parent with pooling on the output edge is weak and near the floor, so deleting edge 2 costs little, while strong parents lose more.
The edit replaces a strong conv on a key edge, so it loses far more than when the replaced op was already weak.
A weak parent with pooling on the direct edge sits near the floor, so removing edge 5 costs comparatively little, whereas strong parents lose much more.
Edge 2 is only active with a working edge 0 feeding node 1, so the conv edit adds a useful strong path there but does nothing in cells where edge 0 is weak or removed.
Replacing a removed direct edge with a 3x3 conv lifts a weak parent far from the floor, a larger gain than replacing an op that already contributes.
